item.title: Curtis ‘50 Cent’ Jackson Was Once Nicknamed Boo Boo
item.description:
[INTRO MUSIC FADES OUT]
Host: Welcome to our show! Today, we're talking about the one and only 50 Cent, also known as Curtis Jackson. He recently stopped by The Tonight Show with Jimmy Fallon to chat about his new TV series and more.
[CLIP OF 50 CENT'S MUSIC PLAYS BRIEFLY]
Host: You might know him as Fifty, Fiddy, or even Boo Boo - a nickname that never quite took off. But one thing's for sure, 50 Cent is a hip-hop star with a lot on his plate. He's just returned from the UK, where his new drama series Fightland was filmed.
[CLIP OF FIGHTLAND THEME MUSIC PLAYS BRIEFLY]
Host: Fightland is a Starz production that explores the world of professional boxing and London's criminal underbelly. 50 Cent is not only the executive producer but also used his influence to bring top talent on board. The series premiered on July 31st and stars Howard Charles as a former heavyweight champion seeking revenge.
[CLIP OF 50 CENT TALKING TO JIMMY FALLON PLAYS BRIEFLY]
Host: But 50 Cent isn't just about drama - he's also passionate about giving back to his community. He recently opened the Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson Community Garden in Queens, inspired by Bette Midler's New York Restoration Project. And, who knew, he's also a fan of comedy? He's expressed interest in producing a scripted comedy show, and Jimmy Fallon has already raised his hand to collaborate.
[OUTRO MUSIC STARTS]
Host: That's all for today. 50 Cent is a true entertainment powerhouse, with a legacy that includes four number one hits on the Billboard Hot 100. We can't wait to see what he does next. Thanks for tuning in! [OUTRO MUSIC CONTINUES TO PLAY]
